_note: 100 realistic, synthetic hostel complaints written by the project team for the triage evaluation (Feasibility Report objective 3). Labels are the category, priority and department a hostel supervisor would assign. They are NOT real student complaints; replace or extend them with supervisor-verified, anonymised real complaints before quoting accuracy as real-world evidence.
